how: Fenghuangling (Phoenix Mountain) natural area in the Western Hills has top-rope, bolted slab and multi-pitch trad routes, reachable by city bus from the Summer Palace; the larger Baihe valley crags are about 90 minutes north.
XuetangX (学堂在线), a Chinese-language MOOC platform, offers online courses to anyone with an internet connection (a free 2D animation course is among those listed).

Cultural Keys ran a one-off traditional Chinese weaving workshop for families at Culture Yard in Beixinqiao (2019, RMB 188 adults); Wtown's Yongshun dye works is also reported to offer loom weaving experiences.

CHAO Printmaking Studio in Sanlitun lists etching among its processes and has run small-group printmaking workshops (2017 sessions, up to 10 people); current schedule must be confirmed with the studio.
CHAO Printmaking Studio in Sanlitun offers lithograph among its printmaking processes and has run small-group workshops (2017 sessions); current schedule must be confirmed with the studio.
Residents tend shared plots in neighbourhood community gardens in Beijing, mostly resident-run or run through neighbourhood committees; no open volunteer sign-up programme was found.
Jubensha (script-killing) role-playing mystery games are played in shops and malls in Beijing, with immersive versions from about RMB 300-500 per person; no dedicated fantasy-LARP club was found.
Johnnie Walker House in Dongcheng runs a members-only whisky club and the annual WHISKY+BEIJING festival offers public tastings, but no independent Beijing whisky society was found.

VIVA, a membership-based professional women's network in Beijing, runs a mentorship programme pairing junior women with senior mentors; other schemes (HKU alumni, a British Chamber walk) are invitation- or alumni-limited.
Informal rail photography is possible at the open-air track area of the China Railway Museum (Dongjiao) and at the display train in 798; no organised train-spotting club was found.
